tasks.short: Inspect manufactured or processed products against specifications.

steps.what: Read contract specifications and legal requirements for the product.
Inspect manufactured or processed products on the bench.
Compare measurements with the contract specifications.
Decide compliance of the products with legal requirements.

tasks.design: The inspector reads the product specification in {CLM}, then inspects the manufactured or processed product. Measurements they enter can be compared with numeric lines. The compliance decision stays with the inspector. Native specification fields are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Product checks were a paper sheet, and the specification was a different document from the measurements.
tasks.enabler_now: The bench inspection stays. A numeric comparison does not see finish, damage or smell.
tasks.still_hard: Products whose specification is not a number, and batches that do not match the paperwork.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector handles the product and decides whether it meets the specification.
tasks.altitude: Bench inspections stay on the week. The decision is still the inspector's.

reach.task: Check a product against a classification fact
reach.learn: Which product facts they refuse to decide from a description alone

evidence.claim: A records screen can list specification lines against measurements a person entered. It cannot decide that a product complies.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: one product batch against one specification. Laboratory testing is another task.

Structured fields are product id, specification line, unit, required value and measured value. The contract produces the required value. The inspector produces the measured value. Fallback: a non-numeric line is left for the bench decision.
Test native specification fields in {CLM} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers product specification lines.
unknowns: Which product specifications are already numeric fields.
Where the inspection happens, at the authority or at the producer.
research_questions: What share of a product check is a measurement rather than a look and a judgement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the specification is descriptive, so the bench inspection is the whole task. High: numeric lines compare themselves and the inspector still inspects and decides. The bench work is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect, identify, evaluate or preserve case evidence.

steps.what: Collect case evidence at the scene.
Identify each item and label it.
Log custody of the evidence in the case file.
Evaluate whether the evidence is relevant.
Preserve the evidence in the store.

tasks.design: Collection, labelling and storage stay with the inspector at the scene and in the store. The custody log in {WORKFLOW} is filled from the label, and the inspector checks it. Relevance is the inspector's decision. Native log fields are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: Custody was a paper sheet that could be filled in after the item had already moved.
tasks.enabler_now: The log can be checked against the label. Picking up, identifying and keeping the item cannot move to a screen.
tasks.still_hard: Items with no safe way to label or store them, and scenes the inspector cannot enter.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector decides what to take and whether it matters to the case.
tasks.altitude: Scene work stays on the week. The inspector can refuse a custody line that does not match the label.

reach.task: Log custody of an item before anyone evaluates it
reach.learn: How they separate the label from the later opinion

evidence.claim: A case log can record a label, a place and a time that a person entered. It cannot collect the item or decide that it is relevant.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: from the scene to stored evidence for one case. Laboratory tests are another task.

Structured fields are case id, item id, label, place and time. The inspector produces all of them at the scene. Fallback: if the log is down, the paper label is the record and is typed in later by the inspector.
Test native log fields in {WORKFLOW} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 1 hour per 100 baseline hours covers the custody fields.
unknowns: Where evidence is stored, and who else may open it.
Whether labels are already scanned into a case system.
research_questions: What share of items is later found to be irrelevant?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the scene is awkward and the log is down, so the paper label is the whole record. High: the log is filled from the label and only checked, while collection, identification and storage stay manual. Relevance is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Submit samples of products to government laboratories for testing.

steps.what: Choose samples of products for testing as required.
Complete the laboratory request for those samples.
Pack and label the samples of products.
Check the request against the packed samples.
Submit the samples to government laboratories.
Record that the laboratories received the samples.

tasks.design: The inspector chooses and packs the samples. The request form in the {GOV_PORTAL} is completed from those choices, and the inspector checks it against the pack. Only that checked version is submitted. Native portal fields are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: The form was retyped from a notebook, and a sample could be sent with the wrong test named.
tasks.enabler_now: Choosing, packing and checking stay. The portal can transmit a form that already matches the pack.
tasks.still_hard: Tests the portal does not list, and samples that cannot be packed safely.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector knows which sample the test requires, and whether the pack matches the form.
tasks.altitude: Packing stays on the week. The inspector can stop a submission whose form does not match the pack.

reach.task: Choose a sample for a laboratory test
reach.learn: Which sample choice they will not leave to a form

evidence.claim: A government portal can accept a completed sample form and return a receipt. It cannot choose the sample or pack it.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: from a test requirement to a submitted sample. The laboratory's own test is not this task.

Structured fields are sample id, product id, test code and pack id. The test requirement produces the test code. The inspector produces the sample and the pack. Fallback: a portal outage means the checked paper form travels with the pack.
Test native fields on the {GOV_PORTAL} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers test codes on the form.
unknowns: Which laboratories accept an electronic request today.
Who may submit a sample in the inspector's name.
research_questions: What share of submissions is refused because the form and the pack disagree?

already_counted.description: Check the request against the pack

incremental.description: Keep laboratory test codes current on the form

approvals.approved_version: request version the inspector checked against the pack

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the portal has no form for this test, so the inspector writes, packs and sends as today. High: a known test code fills the form, and the inspector still chooses, packs and checks. The check is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect government-owned equipment held by private contractors.

steps.what: Arrange access with the private contractors.
Inspect government-owned equipment and materials in their possession.
Compare serials with the contract asset list.
Decide compliance with contracts or regulations, or misuse.

tasks.design: The inspector arranges access and inspects equipment and materials at the contractor. Serials they read can be compared with the asset list in the {ERP}. Whether the use matches the contract, or is misuse, stays a decision. Native asset fields are tested before custom code.
tasks.previous_blocker: The asset list and the contract were separate, so a serial was checked by hand after the visit.
tasks.enabler_now: The visit and the misuse decision stay. A serial match does not show how the equipment is being used.
tasks.still_hard: Contractors who refuse access, and equipment with no serial on the list.
tasks.human_edge: The inspector sees how the equipment is used, which a serial match cannot show.
tasks.altitude: Visits to contractors stay on the week. The misuse decision stays with the inspector.

reach.task: Match equipment on hand to a contract list
reach.learn: How they treat a serial match as a fact and the use as a separate question

evidence.claim: An asset list can show whether a serial the inspector read is on the contract. It cannot decide that the equipment is being misused.

assumptions: Focal role is the property inspector. Boundary: one contractor visit against one contract's asset list. A later notice is another task.

Structured fields are contract id, serial, asset id and location. The contract produces the asset list. The inspector produces the serials seen. Fallback: a serial that will not scan is written down and compared later.
Test native asset fields in the {ERP} before custom code. The US task is read as a European public authority. This task does not monitor staff.
Upkeep of 2 hours per 100 baseline hours covers the asset list.
unknowns: Whether the authority's asset register is the contract list.
How often contractors refuse or delay access.
research_questions: What share of visits finds a use that the serial list cannot describe?

incremental.description: Keep the contract asset list current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: access is difficult and the asset list is stale, so the visit is unchanged. High: serials compare themselves and the inspector still arranges access, inspects, and decides on use. The visit is not removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still sites, products, hearings and files. The inspector can stop a report, a disclosure or a sample submission that is not tied to a note they accepted.
reach: Environmental compliance inspectors: which site measurement they will not take from a photograph
Regulatory affairs specialists: which missing field stops a file
Claims adjusters, examiners, and investigators: how a finding stays tied to a note
skills_to_grow: Refusing a draft sentence that has no source note
Reading a checklist without treating it as a permit decision
Keeping a disclosure inside facts already accepted
role.ambitious_version: Every finding the inspector signs can be traced to a note they accepted, and no permit is granted by a checklist.
